scraped.scraped_description: GOV.UK Notify lets you send emails, text messages and letters to your users. Try it now if you work in central government, a local authority, or the NHS.

name: GOV.UK Notify
tagline: A free notification service for UK government, local authorities, and NHS to send emails, text messages, and letters
sdg_alignment: SDG 16 – Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions
dependency_risks: reliance on Government Digital Service for maintenance and support

academic_citations.citation: Dunleavy, P., et al. (2020). Digital Era Governance: IT Corporations, the State, and E-Government. Oxford University Press

awards: UK Government Digital Service Award for Digital Innovation
policy_outcomes: Standardized notification infrastructure across UK public sector
Reduced costs for government agencies through shared service model
Improved citizen communication from government services
outcome_methodology: administrative data analysis and user adoption metrics
documented_limitations: Limited to UK public sector organizations
Dependent on Government Digital Service for ongoing maintenance
Text message costs apply after free tier
failure_modes: Service outages affecting dependent government services
API rate limiting during high-volume notification periods
curation_criteria: UK public sector organizations only; government, local authority, and NHS services eligible
contributor_governance: open source contributions accepted via GitHub; managed by Government Digital Service team
political_relevance_summary: GOV.UK Notify addresses government technology and public service delivery. A free notification service for UK government, local authorities, and NHS to send emails, text messages, and letters.

movement_building_utility.notes: Provides technical infrastructure that other civic tools or services build upon.

generalizability_notes: Could be adapted to other national contexts with localization. Open-source codebase facilitates replication.
